summary: the Weissenberg number of a shear flow

inputs.name: relaxation_time
inputs.meaning: the relaxation time of the fluid

inputs.name: shear_rate
inputs.meaning: the shear rate of the flow

validity: steady simple shear; other flows use the rate of the flow in question

source.citation: by definition: the product of the fluid's relaxation time and the shear rate
source.locus: the definition used throughout viscoelastic fluid mechanics
